text:
ana: Quick thread - we need language variants + timezone strategy for the May webinar. primary audience NA/EMEA, but APAC interest growing. ideas?

jamal: Short version: landing page in EN, localized social posts for EU (EN + FR/DE) and one APAC-friendly time.

emily: Agree. Also offer 2 live slots? e.g., 10am PT (NA-friendly) and 7pm CET (EMEA-friendly) - but that's heavier ops. Maybe do a recording + a live APAC office hour instead.

parker: What about translated CTAs instead of full landing pages? One-page en + lang-specific social + localized email subject lines. Lower lift.

zara: For technical tweets, DE/FR translations need careful terminology (quantization = "Quantisierung" in DE). We should have native reviewer.

sam: Ops note: if we pick two live slots we need speaker bandwidth and rehearsal windows doubled. prefer single live + APAC office hour async.

ana (typo): *ana :) *

ana: Good take. Let's do single live (10am PT) + 30m APAC office hour next day. Marketing will localize social & email lines; product will prep a ~10min pre-recorded mini-demo for APAC playback.

jamal: Draft social copy variants:
- EN product: "Turn LLM experiments into predictable product features. Join us May 15."
- EN technical: "Benchmarks & tactics to cut per-token cost. Live demo + real-world numbers."

parker: For FR/DE social we'll translate the product copy. I'll route to localization reviewers: claire (FR) and stefan (DE).

emily: Email subjects (A/B):
A: "Webinar: Practical Inference Economics - Save on every token"
B: "How top teams cut LLM costs without slower UX"

riley: CTA translation mapping (important for tracking):
- EN: /signup?utm=webinar0515
- FR: /signup?utm=webinar0515_fr
- DE: /signup?utm=webinar0515_de
Make sure form retains utm and trial checkbox.

zara: Speaker ask: will speakers deliver slides in English only? For APAC office hour we'll use the pre-recorded mini-demo and have a regional PM host the Q&A in local language.

sam: Yes slides English only. regional host idea works. ops: mark rehearsals for main live and a short handoff with APAC host.

jamal: Run-of-show quick draft (45m live + 30m APAC office hour next day):
```
00:00-00:03  Host intro + agenda
00:03-00:12  Keynote: why inference economics (jamal)
00:12-00:24  Deep dive: batching/kv/quant (zara)
00:24-00:32  Customer case study + numbers (Priya)
00:32-00:38  Live demo: routing change + dashboard (zara)
00:38-00:43  Rapid AMA moderated (host)
00:43-00:45  CTA + trial credit link
```

parker: Add slide 1b: "If demo fallback occurs, see note" and a single-line script for host to say.

emily: Rehearsal schedule proposal:
- Dry run (full) 48h prior, 45m
- Tech check 1h prior on day (AV + OBS scenes)
- APAC office hour dry run 24h prior with regional host (20m)

riley: Tracking: add UTM for each channel and language. Also add a custom field to registration form: "preferred_timezone" so we can invite APAC office hour explicitly.

zara: For social translations, request native review turnaround 48h. parker pls confirm reviewers Claire/Stefan availability.

parker: pinged Claire & Stefan. Claire ok, Stefan tentative til EOD.

jamal: Marketing assets checklist:
- landing hero (EN)
- social variants EN/FR/DE
- email A/B subjects + localized subject lines
- registration form with timezone field + trial checkbox
- speaker short bios (EN)
- pre-recorded 10m demo for APAC playback

emily: I can own landing + email. jamal will do social + bios. parker will coordinate localization. zara/sam own pre-recorded demo.

webinar-bot: webinar-bot: speaker prep docs shared: https://drive.redwood/webinars/practical-inference-econ 

ana: small ask - include a one-line privacy blurb on the registration form: "We share anonymized event attendance data with sponsors and partners." confirm legal ok?

parker: legal approved short blurb. added to checklist.

emily: scheduling question - do we open registration immediately or wait till speaker confirmed? recommendation: landing up + registration open with speaker placeholders 'Redwood Engineers + Customer TBD' to capture early signups.

jamal: agree - early signups help us size infra for demo traffic. also lets us pick customer speaker based on registration signals.

riley: final note on metrics: primary KPI = trial signups (via trial checkbox). secondary = attendance rate and APAC office-hour RSVPs. set baseline from prior webinar: 12% trial checkbox conversion.

ana: action items recap (assign):
- emily: build landing + email (due 48h)
- jamal: social copy + bios (due 48h)
- parker: confirm localization reviewers + customer speaker ping (due 72h)
- zara/sam: prep pre-recorded mini-demo (due 1w)
- riley: update registration form with timezone field and UTMs (due 48h)

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: provisional webinar event "Practical Inference Economics" 2024-05-15 10:00 PT created. invites pending.

ana: thanks all - re-sync in 48h in this thread with updates. closing for now :sparkles:
